title: Nice Quality
text: Nice Quality. I have ordered several different sets of decor for tiered trays. I like changing my tray to match the season or holiday. These are some of the better ones that I have ordered online. First, there's a good variety of pieces. Some sets I've seen are all wooden blocks. This includes a gnome, beads, and a furry spider in addition to the wooden blocks. Second, while the wooden blocks are most likely mass produced, they look better than some of the other mass produced blocks I've seen. I've got a few that have a shiny and flat surface. It almost looks like a sticker was slapped on. These blocks look better than those. This is a good value and a great start for your Halloween tiered tray!
